ops.title: askdesk: check taking between individual asks
ops.description:
Owner: desk-roll-on-install implementation caller.
Review scope: staged diff; source inspection only; no tests run.
Severity: minor
Evidence: plugins/long-running/lr/internal/askdesk/askdesk.go:78 — The taking context is checked only after Pass returns, while Pass answers every open ask in the Tail batch using ctx at lines 121-128. A roll during the first ask still starts all remaining queued asks on the old desk, contrary to finishing the ask in hand.
Next executable step: Check taking before each new ask while retaining the original context for the active read and answer post.

ops.text: A roll during the first ask lets that answer complete.
The remaining asks are left for the successor rather than started by the old desk.
